strategy.dream_customer: Adults over 35 who want to get stronger but have stalled on gym programmes made for 20-year-olds.
strategy.where_they_are: Fitness podcasts and Instagram accounts aimed at busy parents.
strategy.hook: Find out why your training stopped working.
strategy.false_belief: I am too old or too busy to get stronger now.
strategy.offer: A personal training type and a plan that fits three sessions a week.
strategy.not_for: Competitive athletes and anyone who needs medical rehab.
strategy.second_yes: A 12-week coached plan offered on the results page.
